raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 15
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted and mis-synthesized the gathered evidence, incorrectly labeling Kir as a digestif/nightcap and stating it is traditionally consumed before bed, despite prior and concurrent credible sources (Difford’s Guide, Wikipedia) indicating Kir is an aperitif (pre-meal) and hot toddy is traditionally a nightcap before retiring. This contradiction of evidence and reversal of roles led toward the wrong conclusion.
